# App shell block

> Next.js layouts with sidebar and header.

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ai-docs.mjs (npm run gen:ai). Do not edit by hand. -->

Install doc for the **App shell block** of ui-kit: 2 variants built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the App shell block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `avatar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/avatar.md
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
   - `breadcrumb`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/breadcrumb.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `card`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/card.md
   - `chart`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/chart.md
   - `dialog`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/dialog.md
   - `kbd`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/kbd.md
   - `command`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/command.md
   - `popover`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/popover.md
   - `dropdown-menu`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/dropdown-menu.md
   - `empty-state`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/empty-state.md
   - `sheet`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/sheet.md
   - `navbar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/navbar.md
   - `separator`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/separator.md
   - `tooltip`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/tooltip.md
   - `sidebar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/sidebar.md
   - `stat`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/stat.md
   - `theme-switch`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/theme-switch.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/avatar.css";
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   @import "./components/breadcrumb.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/card.css";
   @import "./components/chart.css";
   @import "./components/dialog.css";
   @import "./components/kbd.css";
   @import "./components/command.css";
   @import "./components/popover.css";
   @import "./components/dropdown-menu.css";
   @import "./components/empty-state.css";
   @import "./components/sheet.css";
   @import "./components/navbar.css";
   @import "./components/separator.css";
   @import "./components/tooltip.css";
   @import "./components/sidebar.css";
   @import "./components/stat.css";
   @import "./components/theme-switch.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/app-shell/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: App shell

The frame an app's pages render inside: navigation, a header with global controls, and a content area. Two variants, each one self-contained file. In the docs they are framed at 640px high; in an app the same markup fills the page (drop `framed` and the fixed height).

#### Variants
- **Sidebar shell** (`sidebar`): `SidebarProvider framed storageKey={false}` → `Sidebar` (workspace switcher `DropdownMenu` in the header, grouped `SidebarMenuButton`s with icons, tooltips and a count badge, a help row in the footer) + `SidebarInset` (`@container`) holding a sticky 56px header and the page. Header, left to right: `SidebarTrigger`, vertical `Separator`, `Breadcrumb` (workspace › group › page; only the page under 48rem), then search button (icon only under 42rem, "Search…" + ⌘K keycaps above), `ThemeSwitch size="sm"` (from 42rem), account `DropdownMenu` (avatar trigger; profile, billing, settings, a Theme radio group, log out). `CommandDialog` with `hotkey` lists the pages and the theme commands.
- **Top navbar shell** (`top-navbar`): a scroll container (`h-[640px] overflow-y-auto`) with a sticky `Navbar` (brand, five `NavbarLink`s, actions: search and notifications hidden when narrow via `ui-navbar-hide-narrow`, account menu, `NavbarMobileToggle`) and `NavbarMobileMenu` (the links plus a Search button). Below: breadcrumb, `h2` page title with a one-line description and two actions, then a grid of project cards (`Card` with mono title, URL, status `Badge`, area `Sparkline`, deploy time). Mobile menu state is controlled so the search button can close it before opening the palette.

Both: clicking a nav item swaps the page title, breadcrumb and content; pages other than the home one show a dashed `Empty` placeholder.

#### Anatomy (sidebar shell)
```
SidebarProvider (framed, h-[640px], rounded-lg border)
  Sidebar aria-label="App navigation"
    SidebarHeader > workspace switcher (SidebarMenuButton size="lg" as DropdownMenuTrigger)
    SidebarContent > SidebarGroup × 2 > SidebarGroupLabel + SidebarMenu
    SidebarFooter > help row
  SidebarInset.@container.flex.flex-col
    header.sticky.top-0.h-14.border-b.bg-background/85.backdrop-blur
    main.grid.gap-6.p-4 (@2xl:p-6)
  CommandDialog (hotkey)
```

#### Visual rules
- Header: 56px, 1px bottom border, `bg-background/85` with backdrop blur, 12px side padding (16px from 42rem), 8px gaps.
- Sidebar: library defaults (256px, 56px rail, `--ui-sidebar` surface). Only the active row is highlighted.
- Page title 20px/600 (`text-xl`, 24px in the navbar shell), description 14px muted.
- Primary colour is spent on one action per page ("New project") and the brand mark.

#### Behaviour
- Ctrl/⌘ + B collapses the sidebar to the rail (labels clip, tooltips appear); below 768px viewport the sidebar is a sheet opened by the trigger.
- Ctrl/⌘ + K toggles the palette (sidebar shell only, so two shells on one page never fight over the key).
- Theme changes go through `useTheme()`; the switch and the menu radio group stay in sync.

#### Next.js
- Put the shell in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` (Server Component). The interactive parts (`AppSidebar`, `SiteHeader`) are `'use client'` files that read `usePathname()`; pages stay Server Components passed in as `children`.
- `SidebarMenuButton asChild` wraps `next/link`; pass `usePathname()` to `Navbar routeKey` so the mobile menu closes on navigation.
- `ThemeScript` in the root layout's `<head>`, `suppressHydrationWarning` on `<html>`.

#### Accessibility
- Sidebar is a named `aside`; the active row has `aria-current="page"`; the breadcrumb ends with `BreadcrumbPage`.
- Icon-only buttons have names: "Toggle sidebar", "Search", "Notifications, 3 unread", "Account menu, Amina Rahman".
- The search button keeps a visually hidden "Search…" label when it shrinks to an icon.

#### Acceptance checks
- Collapsing the sidebar glides the width 256 → 56px without moving the header controls.
- At 360px: no horizontal overflow; the header shows trigger, current page, search icon and avatar only; the navbar shows brand, avatar and menu button.
- Menus open below their trigger, align to its end, and return focus to it on Esc.

## Variants

Imports are rewritten from the package to the local files (`@/ui/...`).

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from '@/ui/components/breadcrumb';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/components/card';
import { CommandDialog, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandSeparator } from '@/ui/components/command';
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger } from '@/ui/components/dropdown-menu';
import { Empty, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/ui/components/empty-state';
import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from '@/ui/components/kbd';
import { Separator } from '@/ui/components/separator';
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuBadge, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger } from '@/ui/components/sidebar';
import { Stat, StatDelta, StatGroup, StatLabel, StatValue } from '@/ui/components/stat';
import { ThemeSwitch } from '@/ui/components/theme-switch';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';
import { useTheme, type ThemeMode } from '@/ui/theme/use-theme';

interface NavItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: IconName;
  badge?: string;
}

const groups: { label: string; items: NavItem[] }[] = [
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: 'layout-dashboard' },
      { id: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'inbox', badge: '4' },
      { id: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: 'folder' },
      { id: 'analytics', label: 'Analytics', icon: 'bar-chart' },
      { id: 'customers', label: 'Customers', icon: 'users' },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Account',
    items: [
      { id: 'billing', label: 'Billing', icon: 'credit-card' },
      { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' },
    ],
  },
];
const pages = groups.flatMap((g) => g.items.map((item) => ({ ...item, group: g.label })));
const teams = [
  { name: 'Acme Inc', plan: 'Team plan', initials: 'AC' },
  { name: 'Northwind', plan: 'Pro plan', initials: 'NW' },
];
const projects = [
  { name: 'Checkout redesign', owner: 'Amina Rahman', status: 'On track', tone: 'success', updated: '2 h ago' },
  { name: 'Mobile app 3.0', owner: 'Diego Santos', status: 'At risk', tone: 'warning', updated: 'Yesterday' },
  { name: 'Billing migration', owner: 'Grace Liu', status: 'In review', tone: 'info', updated: 'Mon' },
] as const;

export default function AppShellSidebar() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState('overview');
  const [team, setTeam] = useState(teams[0]);
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const { mode, setMode } = useTheme();
  const page = pages.find((p) => p.id === active) ?? pages[0];

  return (
    <SidebarProvider framed storageKey={false} className="h-[640px] rounded-lg border border-border">
      <Sidebar aria-label="App navigation">
        <SidebarHeader>
          <SidebarMenu>
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenu>
                <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                  <SidebarMenuButton size="lg">
                    <Avatar size="sm" shape="rounded">
                      <AvatarFallback>{team.initials}</AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <span className="grid text-start leading-tight">
                      <span className="font-medium">{team.name}</span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{team.plan}</span>
                    </span>
                    <Icon name="chevrons-up-down" className="ml-auto" />
                  </SidebarMenuButton>
                </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                <DropdownMenuContent className="w-56">
                  <DropdownMenuLabel>Workspaces</DropdownMenuLabel>
                  {teams.map((t) => (
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      key={t.name}
                      icon={<Icon name={t.name === team.name ? 'check' : 'globe'} />}
                      onSelect={() => setTeam(t)}
                    >
                      {t.name}
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                  ))}
                  <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                  <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="plus" />}>Create workspace</DropdownMenuItem>
                </DropdownMenuContent>
              </DropdownMenu>
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarHeader>

        <SidebarContent>
          {groups.map((g) => (
            <SidebarGroup key={g.label}>
              <SidebarGroupLabel>{g.label}</SidebarGroupLabel>
              <SidebarMenu>
                {g.items.map((item) => (
                  <SidebarMenuItem key={item.id}>
                    <SidebarMenuButton isActive={active === item.id} tooltip={item.label} onClick={() => setActive(item.id)}>
                      <Icon name={item.icon} />
                      <span>{item.label}</span>
                      {item.badge && <SidebarMenuBadge>{item.badge}</SidebarMenuBadge>}
                    </SidebarMenuButton>
                  </SidebarMenuItem>
                ))}
              </SidebarMenu>
            </SidebarGroup>
          ))}
        </SidebarContent>

        <SidebarFooter>
          <SidebarMenu>
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuButton tooltip="Help and docs">
                <Icon name="info" />
                <span>Help and docs</span>
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarFooter>
      </Sidebar>

      <SidebarInset className="@container flex flex-col">
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex h-14 flex-none items-center gap-2 border-b border-border bg-background/85 px-3 backdrop-blur @2xl:px-4">
          <SidebarTrigger />
          <Separator orientation="vertical" className="mx-1 h-5" />
          <Breadcrumb className="min-w-0">
            <BreadcrumbList>
              <BreadcrumbItem className="hidden @3xl:inline-flex">
                <BreadcrumbLink href="#" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
                  {team.name}
                </BreadcrumbLink>
              </BreadcrumbItem>
              <BreadcrumbSeparator className="hidden @3xl:inline-flex" />
              <BreadcrumbItem className="hidden @3xl:inline-flex">{page.group}</BreadcrumbItem>
              <BreadcrumbSeparator className="hidden @3xl:inline-flex" />
              <BreadcrumbItem>
                <BreadcrumbPage>{page.label}</BreadcrumbPage>
              </BreadcrumbItem>
            </BreadcrumbList>
          </Breadcrumb>

          <div className="ml-auto flex flex-none items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
              className="w-8 justify-center px-0 text-muted-foreground @2xl:w-44 @2xl:justify-start @2xl:px-2.5"
            >
              <Icon name="search" />
              <span className="sr-only @2xl:not-sr-only">Search…</span>
              <KbdGroup className="ml-auto hidden @2xl:inline-flex" aria-hidden="true">
                <Kbd size="sm">⌘</Kbd>
                <Kbd size="sm">K</Kbd>
              </KbdGroup>
            </Button>
            <ThemeSwitch size="sm" className="hidden @2xl:inline-flex" />
            <DropdownMenu>
              <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon aria-label="Account menu, Amina Rahman">
                  <Avatar size="xs">
                    <AvatarFallback>AR</AvatarFallback>
                  </Avatar>
                </Button>
              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
              <DropdownMenuContent placement="bottom-end" className="w-60">
                <DropdownMenuLabel>
                  <span className="block font-medium text-foreground">Amina Rahman</span>
                  <span className="block font-normal">amina@acme.dev</span>
                </DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="user" />}>Profile</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="credit-card" />} onSelect={() => setActive('billing')}>
                  Billing
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="settings" />} onSelect={() => setActive('settings')}>
                  Settings
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Theme</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={mode} onValueChange={(v) => setMode(v as ThemeMode)} aria-label="Theme">
                  <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="light">Light</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
                  <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="dark">Dark</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
                  <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="system">System</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
                </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
                <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                <DropdownMenuItem icon={<Icon name="log-out" />} variant="destructive">
                  Log out
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuContent>
            </DropdownMenu>
          </div>
        </header>

        <main className="grid flex-1 content-start gap-6 p-4 @2xl:p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{page.label}</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {active === 'overview' ? 'Good afternoon, Amina. Here is your week so far.' : `${page.group} · ${team.name}`}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm">
              <Icon name="plus" />
              New project
            </Button>
          </div>

          {active === 'overview' ? (
            <>
              <StatGroup variant="shared" aria-label="This week">
                <Stat>
                  <StatLabel>Active projects</StatLabel>
                  <StatValue>12</StatValue>
                  <StatDelta value="2" direction="up" comparison="new this week" />
                </Stat>
                <Stat>
                  <StatLabel>Open issues</StatLabel>
                  <StatValue>37</StatValue>
                  <StatDelta value="9" direction="down" tone="positive" comparison="vs last week" />
                </Stat>
                <Stat>
                  <StatLabel>Monthly revenue</StatLabel>
                  <StatValue>$48,920</StatValue>
                  <StatDelta value="4.6%" direction="up" comparison="vs last month" />
                </Stat>
              </StatGroup>

              <Card className="min-w-0">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>Recent projects</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>Updated by your team in the last 7 days</CardDescription>
                  <CardAction>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setActive('projects')}>
                      View all
                    </Button>
                  </CardAction>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <ul className="divide-y divide-border" aria-label="Recent projects">
                    {projects.map((p) => (
                      <li key={p.name} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{p.name}</p>
                          <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {p.owner} · {p.updated}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <Badge variant={p.tone} dot className="flex-none">
                          {p.status}
                        </Badge>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </>
          ) : (
            <Empty variant="dashed" className="min-h-64">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia>
                  <Icon name={page.icon} />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle as="h3">{page.label} goes here</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  The shell stays put while this area changes. In Next.js it is the page rendered inside the layout.
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
            </Empty>
          )}
        </main>
      </SidebarInset>

      <CommandDialog open={searchOpen} onOpenChange={setSearchOpen} hotkey title="Search">
        <CommandInput placeholder="Search pages and actions…" />
        <CommandList>
          <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
          <CommandGroup heading="Pages">
            {pages.map((p) => (
              <CommandItem key={p.id} icon={<Icon name={p.icon} />} onSelect={() => setActive(p.id)}>
                {p.label}
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>
          <CommandSeparator />
          <CommandGroup heading="Theme">
            {(['light', 'dark', 'system'] as const).map((m) => (
              <CommandItem
                key={m}
                icon={<Icon name={m === 'light' ? 'sun' : m === 'dark' ? 'moon' : 'monitor'} />}
                keywords={['theme', 'appearance', 'mode']}
                onSelect={() => setMode(m)}
              >
                {`Use ${m} theme`}
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>
        </CommandList>
      </CommandDialog>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';

const sections: { id: string; label: string; icon: IconName; blurb: string }[] = [
  { id: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: 'folder', blurb: 'Everything your team ships, with live traffic.' },
  { id: 'deployments', label: 'Deployments', icon: 'zap', blurb: 'Every build, preview and rollback in one list.' },

  { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings', blurb: 'Team members, billing and integrations.' },
];

  { name: 'storefront', url: 'shop.northwind.dev', status: 'Ready', deployed: '12 min ago', traffic: [32, 35, 31, 40, 44, 41, 48, 52, 50, 58, 61, 66] },

                      variant="area"
                      height={40}
                      color={p.status === 'Failed' ? 'series-4' : 'series-1'}
                      aria-label={`${p.name} visitors, last 12 days`}
                    />
                    <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <Icon name="clock" size={14} />
                      Deployed {p.deployed}
                    </p>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : (
          <Empty variant="dashed" className="min-h-72">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia>
                <Icon name={section.icon} />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle as="h3">{section.label} goes here</EmptyTitle>
              <EmptyDescription>
                The navbar stays put while this area changes. In Next.js it is the page rendered inside the layout.
              </EmptyDescription>
            </EmptyHeader>
          </Empty>
        )}
      </div>

      <CommandDialog open={searchOpen} onOpenChange={setSearchOpen} title="Search">
        <CommandInput placeholder="Search projects and pages…" />
        <CommandList>
          <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
          <CommandGroup heading="Pages">
            {sections.map((s) => (
              <CommandItem key={s.id} icon={<Icon name={s.icon} />} onSelect={() => setActive(s.id)}>
                {s.label}
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>
          <CommandGroup heading="Projects">
            {projects.map((p) => (
              <CommandItem key={p.name} icon={<Icon name="folder" />} keywords={[p.url]} onSelect={() => setActive('projects')}>
                {p.name}
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>
        </CommandList>
      </CommandDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/theme/theme-script.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * <ThemeScript /> — put it in <head> (Next.js: app/layout.tsx). It applies the
 * saved mode, accent and theme pack before the first paint, so there is no
 * light flash and no flash of the default pack.
 * Server Component–safe. Pair with `useTheme()` in client components.
 */

export const THEME_STORAGE = { mode: 'ui-theme-mode', accent: 'ui-theme-accent', pack: 'ui-theme-pack' } as const;

/** Built-in theme packs (styles/tokens/themes). `neutral` = no `data-theme` attribute. */
export type ThemePack = 'neutral' | 'stone' | 'slate' | 'soft' | 'mono';
export const THEME_PACKS: ThemePack[] = ['neutral', 'stone', 'slate', 'soft', 'mono'];

/**
 * Pack: nothing saved → leave whatever the server rendered (`<html data-theme="stone">`);
 * saved `neutral` → remove the attribute; any other saved name → set it.
 * Names are limited to [a-z0-9-] so a tampered value can't do anything odd.
 */
export const themeBootScript = `(function(){try{var d=document.documentElement,m=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.mode}')||'system',a=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.accent}'),p=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.pack}');if(m==='dark'||(m==='system'&&matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches))d.classList.add('dark');if(a&&a!=='neutral')d.setAttribute('data-accent',a);if(p&&/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(p)){if(p==='neutral')d.removeAttribute('data-theme');else d.setAttribute('data-theme',p);}}catch(e){}})();`;

export interface ThemeScriptProps {
  /** CSP nonce, if your app uses one. */
  nonce?: string;
}

export function ThemeScript({ nonce }: ThemeScriptProps) {
  return <script nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeBootScript }} />;
}
```

### `ui/theme/use-theme.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { THEME_STORAGE, type ThemePack } from './theme-script';

export type { ThemePack } from './theme-script';
export type ThemeMode = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
export type ThemeAccent = 'neutral' | 'violet' | 'blue' | 'emerald' | 'rose' | 'amber' | 'orange';
export const THEME_ACCENTS: ThemeAccent[] = ['neutral', 'violet', 'blue', 'emerald', 'rose', 'amber', 'orange'];

const EVENT = 'ui:theme';
const PACK_NAME = /^[a-z0-9-]+$/;

const read = (key: string) => {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(key);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};
const write = (key: string, value: string | null) => {
  try {
    if (value === null) localStorage.removeItem(key);
    else localStorage.setItem(key, value);
  } catch {
    /* storage blocked (private mode) — the change still applies for this page */
  }
};
const systemDark = () => window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;

/** Last pack chosen in this page — keeps working when storage is blocked. */
let sessionPack: string | null = null;

function apply() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const mode = (read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) as ThemeMode | null) ?? 'system';
  const accent = read(THEME_STORAGE.accent);
  const pack = read(THEME_STORAGE.pack) ?? sessionPack;
  // Swap without every element transitioning its colours
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = '*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important}';
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  root.classList.toggle('dark', mode === 'dark' || (mode === 'system' && systemDark()));
  if (accent && accent !== 'neutral') root.setAttribute('data-accent', accent);
  else root.removeAttribute('data-accent');
  // Nothing chosen → keep a pack the server rendered on <html>
  if (pack && PACK_NAME.test(pack)) {
    if (pack === 'neutral') root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    else root.setAttribute('data-theme', pack);
  }
  void root.offsetHeight;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => style.remove());
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT));
}

function subscribe(cb: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener(EVENT, cb);
  window.addEventListener('storage', cb);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT, cb);
    window.removeEventListener('storage', cb);
  };
}

const currentPack = () => read(THEME_STORAGE.pack) ?? sessionPack ?? document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') ?? 'neutral';
const snapshot = () =>
  `${read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) ?? 'system'}|${read(THEME_STORAGE.accent) ?? 'neutral'}|${document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light'}|${currentPack()}`;
const serverSnapshot = () => 'system|neutral|light|neutral';

/**
 * Read and change the theme from any client component.
 *   const { mode, resolvedMode, accent, pack, setMode, setAccent, setPack, toggle } = useTheme();
 */
export function useTheme() {
  const snap = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, serverSnapshot);
  const [mode, accent, resolvedMode, pack] = snap.split('|') as [ThemeMode, ThemeAccent, 'light' | 'dark', ThemePack];

  // Follow the OS while in system mode
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const onChange = () => (read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) ?? 'system') === 'system' && apply();
    mq.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  const setMode = useCallback((next: ThemeMode) => {
    write(THEME_STORAGE.mode, next === 'system' ? null : next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  const setAccent = useCallback((next: ThemeAccent) => {
    write(THEME_STORAGE.accent, next === 'neutral' ? null : next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  /** Built-in pack or the name of your own `[data-theme="…"]` pack ([a-z0-9-]). */
  const setPack = useCallback((next: ThemePack | (string & {})) => {
    if (!PACK_NAME.test(next)) return;
    // `neutral` is stored explicitly: it must also override a pack the server rendered
    sessionPack = next;
    write(THEME_STORAGE.pack, next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  const toggle = useCallback(() => setMode(resolvedMode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'), [resolvedMode, setMode]);

  return { mode, resolvedMode, accent, pack, setMode, setAccent, setPack, toggle };
}
```
